ruleset.name: Readable control flow
ruleset.description: Limit cognitive complexity and mixed control-flow nesting in production and test Java.

rule.name: ControlFlowNesting
rule.message: Control-flow nesting exceeds 3 levels; use a guard clause or a focused helper.
rule.description: Count mixed if, loop, switch and try nesting within each executable body. Else-if chains do not add nesting, and nested methods and lambdas start a new body.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $bodies := //*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::CompactConstructorDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression or self::Initializer], $controls := //*[self::IfStatement[not(parent::IfStatement[@Else = true()]/*[last()] is .)] or self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::SwitchStatement or self::SwitchExpression or self::TryStatement] return for $node in $controls return let $body := $node/ancestor::*[. intersect $bodies][1] return $node[count(ancestor-or-self::*[. intersect $controls] [ancestor::*[. intersect $bodies][1] is $body]) > 3]
